metadata.description: Official Cursor plugin marketplace: developer tools, framework rules, MCP integrations, and agent skills

plugins.name: teaching
plugins.description: Skill mapping, practice plans, and learning retrospectives.

plugins.name: continual-learning
plugins.description: Incremental transcript-driven memory updates for AGENTS.md using high-signal bullet points only.

plugins.name: titen-memory
plugins.description: Connect Cursor to an operator-selected Titen MCP server for explicit, evidence-grounded collaborative memory.

plugins.name: cursor-team-kit
plugins.description: Internal team workflows used by Cursor developers for CI, code review, shipping, local automation, and verification.

plugins.name: thermos
plugins.description: Thermo-nuclear branch review: deep security/correctness audits, harsh code-quality rubrics, parallel subagents, thermos orchestration, and optional merge-ready PR flows.

plugins.name: create-plugin
plugins.description: Scaffold and validate new Cursor plugins.

plugins.name: ralph-loop
plugins.description: Iterative self-referential AI loops using the Ralph Wiggum technique.

plugins.name: agent-compatibility
plugins.description: CLI-backed repo compatibility scans plus Cursor agents that audit startup, validation, and docs against reality.

plugins.name: cli-for-agent
plugins.description: Patterns for designing CLIs that coding agents can run reliably: flags, help with examples, pipelines, errors, idempotency, dry-run.

plugins.name: pr-review-canvas
plugins.description: Render PR diffs as interactive Cursor Canvases organized for reviewer comprehension — groups changes by importance, separates boilerplate from core logic, and highlights tricky or unexpected code.

plugins.name: docs-canvas
plugins.description: Render documentation — architecture notes, API references, runbooks, and codebase walkthroughs — as a navigable Cursor Canvas with sections, table of contents, diagrams, and cross-references.

plugins.name: cursor-sdk
plugins.description: Build apps, scripts, CI pipelines, and automations on top of the Cursor TypeScript SDK (@cursor/sdk) — runtime selection, auth, streaming, MCP, error handling, and ready-to-extend integration patterns.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Fan large tasks out across parallel Cursor cloud agents with planners, workers, verifiers, and structured handoffs.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: if you want to go fast, go deep first. pstack helps you write less, but higher quality code. rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Connect Cursor to Gmail via Google's remote MCP server — search, read, draft, label, and manage email.

plugins.name: google-drive
plugins.description: Connect Cursor to Google Drive via Google's remote MCP server — search, read, create, share, and manage files.

plugins.name: google-calendar
plugins.description: Connect Cursor to Google Calendar via Google's remote MCP server — list calendars, search events, and create or update meetings.

plugins.name: gong
plugins.description: Gong MCP integration for revenue intelligence — account summaries, deal insights, and call briefs.

plugins.name: salesforce
plugins.description: Connect Cursor to Salesforce via Salesforce Hosted MCP — query, search, create, update, and traverse records in your org.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Drive a real browser for agents — navigate pages, click and fill elements, take snapshots and screenshots, and run end-to-end checks — via Microsoft's Playwright MCP server.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Connect Cursor to GitHub — repositories, issues, pull requests, code search, and Actions — via GitHub's official remote MCP server.

plugins.name: apollo-io
plugins.description: Connect Cursor to Apollo.io — prospect search, contact and company enrichment, lists, sequences, and one-off emails — via Apollo's official remote MCP server.

plugins.name: ashby
plugins.description: Connect Cursor to Ashby — search candidates and jobs, prep for interviews, manage pipeline tasks, and take recruiting actions — via Ashby's official remote MCP server.

plugins.name: zoom
plugins.description: Zoom MCP integration — search meetings and recordings, pull summaries and transcripts, and work with Zoom Docs.

plugins.name: x
plugins.description: Read-only access to the X API — search posts and users, read timelines and mentions, and pull trends and news — via X's official hosted MCP server.
